task: Accuracy of a visible output hole using exterior graphical workspace; not compression or same-model fidelity
prior: theta ~ N(0,(tau I + signed weighted Laplacian)^-1)
observations: 48 noisy external values; no observation at the query; all policies see the same available observations and graph
primary: Within paired condition, t16 true NMSE less than frozen exterior t16/reset2x8 (the latter cost the same full16 sweeps); 95% seed paired CI strictly positive and sign accuracy CI positive. Conditional mechanism test, not superiority to all algorithms.
secondary: Compare to optimal posterior using only distance1 evidence, and to all-evidence direct Bayes solver; equal-update Gauss-Seidel; global calibrated mean. No information advantage as a compute-efficiency claim.
statistics: 10 graph/data seeds. Exact Gaussian expectations primary, MC secondary. Shared base random draws across noise/tau; these are not independent seeds.
control_notes: Fewer observations in local Bayesian baseline; it diagnoses unused information, not equal-input general optimality. Different graph families induce different priors, so cross-family accuracy is NOT graph-only causal evidence.
stopping: All specified conditions. No result-dependent seed replacement, stopping, or parameter adjustment.
work_accounting: Jacobi vs reset uses same n*T node updates and 2*edge_count*T edge terms. Gaussian direct and scalar readout have different setup/cost, reported but no speed benchmark claimed.
timestamp_note: Frozen locally before running evaluation, not externally preregistered.
